title: Travel Agent Quote Generation Automation
summary: Turn a holiday enquiry into a costed, day-wise itinerary and quote from your contracted rates, supplier sheets and margin rules, ready for the consultant to check and send on WhatsApp.

seo.title: Travel Agent Quote Generation with AI | VipraTech
seo.description: AI that builds day-wise itineraries and costed quotes from contracted hotel and DMC rates, transfers and margin rules, for consultants to check and send.

designed_for: Operations Executive at a tour operator or DMC

problem.intro: A typical holiday enquiry, such as a family wanting five nights in Kerala over the Christmas holidays in mid-range hotels, can take a consultant hours to quote. They look up contracted hotel rates with seasonal supplements, transfer and sightseeing costs, flight options and margins across spreadsheets and PDFs, then format an itinerary. By the time it is sent, the customer has received quotes from other agents.

pain_points.title: Rates scattered across sheets
pain_points.detail: Hotel contracts, DMC rate sheets, transfer tariffs and sightseeing costs sit in different files, each with seasons, supplements and blackout dates.

pain_points.title: Slow first quote
pain_points.detail: Customers ask several agents at once, and the first credible itinerary often wins the booking.

pain_points.title: Costing mistakes
pain_points.detail: Missed child or extra-bed supplements, peak-date surcharges, or GST and TCS on overseas packages erode margin or force awkward revisions.

pain_points.title: Inconsistent itineraries
pain_points.detail: Each consultant formats quotes differently, with varying detail on inclusions, exclusions and cancellation terms.

solution.overview: We build a quote engine that reads the enquiry from WhatsApp, email or a web form and asks for missing details: dates, travellers and ages, hotel category, budget and interests. It drafts a day-wise route from your preferred circuits and realistic travel times, selects hotels and services from your contracted rates, which we extract from hotel contracts and DMC sheets into a structured rate store, and calculates the cost with supplements, taxes and your margin rules. The consultant sees the itinerary and costing sheet side by side, edits as needed and sends a branded quote as a PDF or WhatsApp message. Revisions keep a version history.
capabilities: Enquiry parsing from WhatsApp, email and web forms, with prompts for missing details
Rate store built from hotel contracts and DMC sheets, with seasons, supplements and blackout dates
Day-wise itinerary drafting from your preferred circuits and realistic travel times
Costing with child and extra-bed supplements, peak surcharges, configured taxes and margins
Consultant review screen with itinerary and costing side by side
Branded PDF and WhatsApp quotes with version history and follow-up reminders

workflow.title: Receive the enquiry
workflow.detail: An enquiry arrives by WhatsApp, email or web form and is parsed into structured requirements.

workflow.title: Fill gaps
workflow.detail: Missing details such as children's ages, hotel category or date flexibility are requested before costing.

workflow.title: Draft the itinerary
workflow.detail: A day-wise route is drafted from your preferred circuits, with hotels and services chosen from contracted rates.

workflow.title: Calculate the cost
workflow.detail: The engine applies seasons, supplements, taxes and margin rules, and flags any missing or expired rate.

workflow.title: Consultant review
workflow.detail: The consultant checks the itinerary and costing, adjusts choices and approves the quote.

workflow.title: Send and follow up
workflow.detail: A branded quote goes out as a PDF or on WhatsApp, and follow-up reminders are scheduled.

inputs: Customer enquiries from WhatsApp, email and web forms
Hotel contracts and DMC rate sheets in Excel or PDF
Preferred circuits and travel time rules
Margin rules and tax settings confirmed by your accountant
outputs: Costing sheet showing each component, supplement and tax
Missing or expired rate alerts for operations
Quote versions and follow-up tasks in the CRM
human_in_the_loop: The consultant reviews and approves every quote before it is sent, and operations confirms availability with hotels and suppliers before booking. Tax treatment and margins are set by the agency and its accountant, not by the model.
integrations: Travel agency CRM or back-office system
Hotel and DMC contract files in Excel or PDF
Supplier or bedbank APIs where you use them
guardrails: Prices come only from the rate store and margin rules, never generated by the model
Expired or missing rates flagged, not estimated
Quotes marked subject to availability until operations confirms
Inclusions, exclusions and cancellation terms drawn from approved templates
Every quote versioned with the rates used
compliance_notes: GST, and TCS on overseas tour packages, are applied as configured by your accountant; the system does not determine tax treatment.
Customer details are processed for quoting and booking under the DPDP Act 2023.

pilot.scope: Two or three domestic circuits your team sells most, using your current hotel and DMC contracts, with consultants comparing generated quotes with their own.
deliverables: Rate store built from the pilot contracts
Itinerary and costing rules for the pilot circuits
Consultant review screen and quote template
Pilot comparison of generated and manual quotes

what_we_measure.how: Time from enquiry to quote sent, compared with manual quotes in the same period.
Generated costs compared with consultant-checked costing for the same enquiries.
Count and type of changes made before sending.
Bookings from generated quotes, tracked in the CRM.

faqs.q: Our rates come in many formats from hotels and DMCs. Can it read them?
faqs.a: Yes. Contract PDFs and Excel sheets are extracted into the rate store, including seasons, room categories, meal plans, supplements and blackout dates. Operations reviews each extracted contract once before it is used for pricing.
Not in the first phase. It produces quotes and itineraries, and booking stays with operations, who confirm availability with suppliers. Supplier API booking can be added later where you have access.

faqs.q: Can it handle international packages and flights?
faqs.a: Yes, with your contracted rates and supplier feeds. Flight prices change quickly, so quotes show flights as indicative unless operations confirms a fare.

faqs.q: Does it handle GST and TCS?
faqs.a: It applies the GST and TCS settings your accountant configures for each package type and shows them as separate lines. It does not decide tax treatment.
